project.name: Comunicador
project.productType: Windows desktop application for internal messaging and remote computer management

motion.status: change only when data changes; never pulse continuously

must: Keep the existing WPF application and light/dark theme support.
Keep computer cards compact and preserve nickname, ping, role badges, device status and versions.
Honor reduced motion and show visible keyboard focus.
avoid: Do not add a web runtime or open secondary application windows.
Do not animate status text continuously or hide device actions behind hover only.

decisions: Use an operational dashboard hierarchy: a clear section header, one compact metric, stable device cards, and status shown by a narrow colored edge.
Keep the six navigation labels visible and place download progress beside the ping instead of replacing the current page.
Use native WPF controls while adapting 21st catalog patterns; preserve the selected accent palette and reduced-motion setting.
evidence: 21st Card Status List (2514): compact state indicators and explicit completed/syncing states.
21st Insight Cards (29167): restrained metric typography and compact surface hierarchy.
